purpose: Evaluate every NKK or BLK against every governed Sentimeant theme, record how well each theme fits, and isolate every KK or KOMBO with no defensible theme fit.

themes.label: Winning
themes.meaning: Celebrate achievement, progress, courage, recognition, or a meaningful victory.

themes.label: Loving
themes.meaning: Express affection, devotion, closeness, belonging, or enduring care.

themes.label: Remembering
themes.meaning: Honor shared history, memory, absence, anniversary, legacy, or someone held in mind.

themes.label: Sharing
themes.meaning: Reveal, include, thank, reconnect, or communicate a meaningful experience or truth.

themes.label: Urging
themes.meaning: Encourage action, persistence, courage, return, repair, or movement toward something better.

themes.label: Comforting
themes.meaning: Soothe, reassure, accompany, acknowledge hurt, or help someone feel less alone.

themes.label: Reinforcing
themes.meaning: Affirm identity, worth, belonging, pride, resilience, commitment, or a truth worth repeating.

fit_levels.label: Strong fit
fit_levels.rule: Meaning, relationship or point of view, desired effect, and actual audio presentation align; no material contradiction is present.

fit_levels.label: Supported fit
fit_levels.rule: At least three independent evidence dimensions align, including actual audio presentation, with no material contradiction. This remains a candidate until all product gates and review decisions pass.

fit_levels.label: Possible fit — review
fit_levels.rule: At least three independent attention signals exist, but one or more required proof dimensions remain incomplete. It is not customer eligible.

fit_levels.label: No fit
fit_levels.rule: Fewer than three independent signals align, or a material contradiction defeats the proposed theme.

no_theme_fit_isolation.label: NO THEME FIT — HOLD
no_theme_fit_isolation.rule: If no governed theme reaches at least Possible fit, isolate the KK or KOMBO from Sentimeant presentation. Preserve it for other valid uses, later metadata improvement, or GD review; do not force it into a theme.
